scenes.title: Brain Reward
scenes.text: Music lights up the same reward centers in your brain as food and pleasure, releasing dopamine when a song hits.

scenes.title: Stuck Song
scenes.text: A song stuck in your head is called an earworm, and it happens to nearly everyone, sometimes for hours on end.

scenes.title: Instant Mood
scenes.text: Your brain recognizes a familiar song in a fraction of a second, and your mood can change just as fast.

scenes.title: Natural Relief
scenes.text: Music can lower pain and stress, which is why doctors use it to calm patients before difficult procedures.

scenes.title: Time Machine
scenes.text: Songs tie to memory so strongly that one note can transport you back to a moment you had forgotten.

scenes.title: Born To Hear
scenes.text: Babies respond to rhythm before they can speak, and a gentle song can calm them faster than words.

scenes.title: Not Just Us
scenes.text: Other animals feel rhythm too, and some birds and even rats move in time to a steady beat.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Music shapes how you feel every single day. What song always puts you in a better mood?
